title: 第6章 打破万古极境，君玲珑要追随？
content_zh:
君仗剑五百万斤的记录，在泰岳古碑保持了许久。
倒不是说整个君家年轻一辈就他最强。
其余序列，很多都在外修炼或者闭关，根本没有在泰岳古碑检测肉身力量。
此刻，看到君逍遥欲要出手，全场目光齐齐汇聚。
毕竟君逍遥是含着金汤匙出生，生下来就被封为神子。
他的一举一动，都受到四方瞩目。
若是君逍遥的表现欠佳，众人虽不敢明面嘲讽什么，但心里显然也会有些微辞。
隐于虚空中的君战天，也是罕见地有些紧张起来。
能不能在君家，第一次树立起威信，就看君逍遥这一次的表现了。
君逍遥本人倒是没有想这么多，只是单纯突破后，想检测一下实力。
他五指握拳，简简单单，没有丝毫花哨。
君逍遥感觉体内，好似有一千头巨象在奔涌，恐怖的力量由筋脉肌肉传递到拳锋之上。
君逍遥一拳轰击在泰岳古碑上，背后那头金色神象虚影，好似也随同轰击而出。
霎时间，整座古碑剧烈轰鸣颤抖！
一个刺目的数字，出现在了泰岳古碑之上。
一千万斤！
所有君家子弟，满目骇然之色，拼命揉着眼睛，无法相信眼前所见！
年仅三岁，一千万斤巨力！
如果不是亲眼所见，他们根本不会相信！
兰清雅瞪大了倩眸，娇躯都是打颤了一下，心灵受到了深深的震撼！

虽然她不愿承认，但泰岳古碑，从来都没有出过错！
君玲珑亦是美眸一震，更加确定了内心的猜想。
甚至就连隐于暗处的君战天，老脸都是呆住，显得有些滑稽。
然而事情并未结束！
一道道裂缝，以君逍遥的拳头为中心，如蛛网一般，朝着四面八方蔓延。
“这……”
君逍遥自己也是愣了愣。
他发誓，自己绝对不是故意毁坏公物的。
在所有人呆然的目光当中，泰岳古碑寸寸碎裂，最后直接是崩灭开来，碎成无数块。
在崩灭的同时，一道仿佛自远古传来的声音，响彻整个君家！
“再创万古极境，赐天道奖励！”
这声音从虚空传来，无比恢弘，仿佛一位大帝在低语喃喃。
但说出的话，却是令十方骇然！
万古极境！
这代表了什么？
代表从古至今，无数纪元，在君逍遥这个年纪，没有人比他肉身力量更强。
哪怕是古之大帝，古皇至尊，在三岁时，肉身方面也比不上君逍遥！
这绝对是一个恐怖无比的记录！
相比之下，君仗剑那五百万斤的记录，显然那么寒碜。
“神子大人，打破了万古极境！”君玲珑美目炽亮无比，闪过异彩。

如果之前，她只是有所猜测，那么现在，她已经有了五成的把握！
君逍遥，可能就是那一角未来中，背对众生的无敌存在！
兰清雅则是脸色苍白，这个记录，太过可怕，她甚至根本无法想象。
想起之前还猜测君逍遥只有十万斤巨力，兰清雅就觉得有些尴尬，脸色尬红。
“哈哈，孙子，厉害啊！”
君战天忍不住从虚空现身，满面红光，笑的合不拢嘴。
君逍遥嘴角抽抽，这话听着怎么像是在骂人呢？
其余君家弟子看到君战天现身，纷纷躬身道：“见过族老！”
“爷爷，这泰岳古碑碎了……”君逍遥无语道。
“没事，碎了就碎了，你可是又给我君家带来了一个大大的惊喜啊！”君战天喜不自禁。
相比于君逍遥创下的万古记录，一座泰岳古碑碎了，算什么事？
这时，虚空之中，一团混沌光芒浮现而出，最后落在了君逍遥手中。
这是打破了万古极境的奖励。
君逍遥定睛一看，发现是一块玉简。
一股神念探入其中，君逍遥赫然发现，这玉简内记载的，是一种至高的炼魂法门。
混沌神魔观想法！
“有意思，这是要让我肉身和神魂皆无敌吗？”
君逍遥暗笑。
他肉身已经打破极境，古来无双，加上这至高炼魂法门，到时候肉身神魂皆圆满，谁人可敌？
君逍遥想着，收起玉简，决定日后再仔细参悟。

这时，远处有光虹掠来，乃是一位君家地位颇高的族老，朗声喝道。
“十八祖有感，万古极境被打破，奖励君逍遥神子三株不死神药！”
这位族老的话，再度令四方哗然。
一群君家弟子，嫉妒地眼红无比！
不死神药可是极为珍贵的存在。
一般而言，哪怕是仙域的一流势力，也可能只有一两株不死神药。
君家虽是荒古世家，底蕴丰厚，但不死神药也没有多少。
一下就赏赐三株不死神药，这在之前君家，从未发生过！
不过一想到君逍遥打破了万古记录，这个奖励，好像也理所应当。
兰清雅被震撼地都是有些麻木了。
她到现在还深深记得，君仗剑曾经有幸得到过一株不死神药，简直是将其当祖宗一样供着，都不舍得用。
但君逍遥，一下就得到三株，这种对比反差，太过巨大。
“代我转告，多谢十八祖赏赐。”君逍遥不骄不躁，从容说道。
他也是准备回天帝宫闭关，消化这次成果了。
君玲珑微微迟疑，咬了咬玉唇，还是踏出莲步，心情忐忑道：“神子请留步。”
“嗯？”君逍遥侧头，便是看到了君玲珑。
她一身宫装包裹着初露规模的玲珑身段。
金色微卷长发晶莹而耀眼，衬托地一张无暇玉脸更是雪白细腻，气质无双。
“你是？”君逍遥疑惑。
“小女子君玲珑，见过逍遥神子。”君玲珑略显局促道。

她性格一向淡然自若，气质娇贵高雅。
但此刻面对君逍遥，君玲珑却感觉自己平凡到了骨子里，根本升不起半点高傲之气。
“有事？”君逍遥淡淡道。
金发妹子看上去的确很养眼，但君逍遥也不是看见女人就走不动路的类型。
因此，君逍遥态度倒是颇为平淡。
君玲珑心里罕见的有些忐忑，她对着君逍遥道了一礼后，启唇说道。
“玲珑希望，能够成为神子的追随者！”
一语落下，整个斗武场死寂一片。
许多君家男性子弟，脸色苍白，心碎了一地。
在他们眼中，高高在上，只可远观不可亵玩的玲珑贵女，此刻却是屈身下拜，主动提出成为别人的追随者。
这种感觉，就好像是自己心目中的女神，主动要成为别人的玩物一般。
content_en:
The record of Jun Zhan's sword weighing five million kilograms has been maintained in the Taiyue Ancient Monument for a long time.
It's not that he is the strongest among the entire younger generation of the Jun family.
For the rest of the sequences, many were practicing outside or in seclusion, and did not test the physical strength at the Taiyue Ancient Monument at all.
At this moment, seeing Jun Xiaoyao about to take action, all eyes in the audience gathered.
After all, Jun Xiaoyao was born with a silver spoon in his mouth, and he was named the Son of God when he was born.
His every move attracted attention from all sides.
If Jun Xiaoyao's performance was not good, although everyone would not dare to ridicule him openly, they would obviously be a little bit dissatisfied in their hearts.
Jun Zhantian, who was hiding in the void, was also unusually nervous.
Whether he can establish prestige in the Jun family for the first time depends on Jun Xiaoyao's performance this time.
Jun Xiaoyao himself didn't think so much, he just wanted to test his strength after breaking through.
He made a fist with five fingers, simple and not fancy at all.
Jun Xiaoyao felt as if there were a thousand giant elephants rushing inside his body, and the terrifying power was transmitted from the muscles to the fist.
Jun Xiaoyao punched the ancient monument of Taiyue, and the shadow of the golden elephant behind him seemed to come out with the attack.
In an instant, the entire ancient monument roared and trembled violently!
A dazzling number appeared on the ancient monument of Mount Tai.
Ten million pounds!
All the children of the Jun family looked in shock, rubbing their eyes desperately, unable to believe what they were seeing!
He is only three years old and has a strength of 10 million kilograms!
If they hadn't seen it with their own eyes, they wouldn't have believed it!
Lan Qingya's beautiful eyes widened, her delicate body trembled, and her soul was deeply shocked!
Although she didn't want to admit it, there was never anything wrong with the Taiyue Ancient Monument!
Jun Linglong's beautiful eyes trembled, confirming her inner suspicion.
Even Jun Zhantian, who was hiding in the dark, had a blank look on his face, looking a little funny.
But things are not over yet!
A series of cracks, centered on Jun Xiaoyao's fist, spread in all directions like a spider web.
"This..."
Jun Xiaoyao himself was stunned.
He swore that he never intentionally destroyed public property.
Under everyone's blank gaze, the Taiyue Ancient Monument was shattered inch by inch, and finally collapsed and broke into countless pieces.
At the same time as it collapsed, a voice that seemed to come from ancient times resounded throughout the Jun family!
"Create the eternal realm again and be rewarded by heaven!"
This voice came from the void, extremely majestic, as if a great emperor was whispering.
But what he said shocked Shi Fang!
The ultimate realm of eternity!
What does this mean?
It means that from ancient times to the present, for countless epochs, no one at Jun Xiaoyao's age has stronger physical strength than him.
Even the Great Ancient Emperor, the Supreme Ancient Emperor, was physically inferior to Jun Xiaoyao when he was three years old!
This is definitely a terrifying record!
In comparison, Jun Zhanjian's record of five million kilograms is obviously so shabby.
"Lord Son of God, you have broken the eternal realm!" Jun Linglong's beautiful eyes were extremely bright, flashing with extraordinary splendor.
If she had just made a guess before, now she is 50% sure!
Jun Xiaoyao may be the invincible existence in that corner of the future, turning his back on all sentient beings!
Lan Qingya's face turned pale. This record was so terrifying that she couldn't even imagine it.
Remembering that she had guessed that Jun Xiaoyao had only one hundred thousand kilograms of strength, Lan Qingya felt a little embarrassed and her face turned red.
"Haha, grandson, that's awesome!"
Jun Zhantian couldn't help but appear from the void, his face glowing red and smiling from ear to ear.
The corner of Jun Xiaoyao's mouth twitched. Why did this sound like he was cursing someone?
When the other Jun family disciples saw Jun Zhantian appear, they all bowed and said, "I've met the clan elder!"
"Grandpa, this ancient Taiyue monument is broken..." Jun Xiaoyao said speechlessly.
"It's okay. If it breaks, it will break. You have brought another big surprise to my Jun family!" Jun Zhantian couldn't help but be happy.
Compared with Jun Xiaoyao's eternal achievements,Record, if an ancient Taiyue monument is broken, what does it mean?
At this time, a ball of chaotic light emerged from the void, and finally fell into Jun Xiaoyao's hands.
This is the reward for breaking through the eternal realm.
Jun Xiaoyao took a closer look and found that it was a jade slip.
A spiritual thought penetrated into it, and Jun Xiaoyao suddenly discovered that what was recorded in this jade slip was a supreme soul refining method.
The concept of chaos gods and demons!
"Interesting, does this make me both physically and mentally invincible?"
Jun Xiaoyao chuckled secretly.
His physical body has broken through the extreme realm, which is unparalleled in ancient times. With this supreme soul refining method, when the physical body, spirit and soul are both perfect, who can be defeated?
Jun Xiaoyao thought about it, put away the jade slip, and decided to study it carefully in the future.
At this time, there was a rainbow of light coming from the distance, and it was an elder of the Jun family with a high status, shouting loudly.
"The Eighteenth Ancestor feels that the Eternal Realm has been broken, and he will reward the Son of God Jun Xiaoyao with three immortal elixirs!"
The clan elder's words once again caused uproar in all directions.
A group of Jun family disciples were extremely jealous!
The elixir of immortality is an extremely precious existence.
Generally speaking, even the first-rate forces in the Immortal Realm may only have one or two immortal medicines.
Although the Jun family is an ancient family with rich heritage, it does not have much elixir of immortality.
Rewarding three immortal medicines at once, this has never happened before in the Jun family!
But when I think about Jun Xiaoyao breaking the eternal record, this reward seems to be a natural one.
Lan Qingya was so shocked that she became a little numb.
She still vividly remembers that Jun Zhanjian was once lucky enough to obtain an elixir of immortality. He simply offered it to his ancestors and was reluctant to use it.
But Jun Xiaoyao got three plants at once. The contrast was too huge.
"Tell me, thank you Eighteenth Ancestor for the reward." Jun Xiaoyao said calmly without being arrogant or impetuous.
He is also preparing to return to the Emperor's Palace for retreat to digest the results of this time.
Jun Linglong hesitated slightly, bit her jade lips, and then stepped out of the lotus steps, saying anxiously: "Son of God, please stay."
"Huh?" Jun Xiaoyao turned his head and saw Jun Linglong.
She was dressed in palace attire, covering her delicate figure that was just beginning to show off.
The long golden slightly curly hair is crystal clear and dazzling, and the flawless jade face set off is even more snow-white and delicate, with an unparalleled temperament.
"Who are you?" Jun Xiaoyao was confused.
"The little girl Jun Linglong has met the Son of God Xiaoyao." Jun Linglong said slightly embarrassed.
She has always been calm and composed, with a delicate and elegant temperament.
But facing Jun Xiaoyao at this moment, Jun Linglong felt that she was ordinary to the core and could not feel any arrogance at all.
"Is something wrong?" Jun Xiaoyao said calmly.
The blonde girl does look very attractive, but Jun Xiaoyao is not the type who can't walk when he sees a woman.
Therefore, Jun Xiaoyao's attitude was quite calm.
Jun Linglong felt a little uneasy in her heart. After bowing to Jun Xiaoyao, she opened her lips and said.
"Linglong hopes to become a follower of the Son of God!"
As soon as the words fell, the entire fighting arena fell into dead silence.
Many male members of the Jun family were pale and their hearts were broken.
In their eyes, the exquisite lady who was aloof and could only be watched from a distance but not played with was now bowing down and offering to become someone else's follower.
This feeling is as if the goddess in my mind actively wants to become someone else's plaything.
